findings.title: Registered single-field dynamic expansions have no production preview row
findings.root_cause: Daemon ergopti_hotstrings.lua:1499-1512 composes static candidates and manager.preview_candidates only. Aliases/dates register solely in shared dynamic engine (manager.lua:209,221); prefix_mappings exports no such rows. preview_candidates intentionally drops single-field tags at manager.lua:594 and dates at :587. The resolving M.preview API at :621 has no daemon caller.
findings.silent_failure: Supported expansions fire but their preview is absent without warnings.
findings.regression_test: Drive actual daemon candidate composition for enabled/disabled single aliases and each date family, asserting one masked/classified row only when admitted; include multi-field positive control and unknown boundary refusal.

findings.title: Invisible previews increment offered-suggestion metrics
findings.root_cause: ergopti_hotstrings.lua:1529 ignores the boolean returned by preview.show and unconditionally commits offered state / metric at :1538-1540. ui/tooltip/preview.lua:431-433 and :451 return false for disabled toggle/category/unavailable renderer. keystats.lua:1083 persists offered counters.
findings.silent_failure: hs_suggested grows for offers never displayed, silently skewing acceptance data and deduplication.
findings.regression_test: Refuse preview for disabled toggle, category and unavailable renderer; assert no offered telemetry/deduplication commit. Then successfully show the same row and assert one count across redraws.

findings.title: Built-in dynamic expansions bypass configured expansion-delay admission
findings.root_cause: within_delay in ergopti_hotstrings.lua:1340 only guards static results/cascade. Late dynamic dispatch at :1575 supplies buffer, key, boundary and destination but no timing admission. manager.on_trigger at manager.lua:465 and combo path at :399 never consult delay or timing. Programmable path independently applies proper timing at infra/user_hotstring_runtime.lua:35-37. Windows built-in date registrations carry TimeActivationSeconds (dynamic_hotstrings.ahk:135).
findings.silent_failure: A built-in dynamic expansion commits after its configured deadline while ordinary prefix/static expansion respects it.
findings.regression_test: Drive actual daemon callback with fake monotonic times and resolved dynamic delay for alias/date/combo routes, testing below/exact/above deadline, zero, missing timing and complex keys with a longer idle threshold.

findings.title: Production Linux physical shortcut editor and active physical-action delivery remain unqualified and unavailable
findings.silent_failure: Not silent in runtime: menu/bridge correctly refuse. Audit/inventory can falsely claim conditional availability because shared editor assets, native observer and controlled host tests exist.
findings.regression_test: Pin documented unavailable status to actual production getter; keep a real getter -> bridge -> menu test showing unavailable regardless of GUI readiness. When enabling later, require evidence of qualified end-to-end native source/all-owner collision/output custody rather than replacing the guard with true.
findings.other_os: macOS keyboard_shortcuts.lua:525 also returns false (unqualified broker/output); Windows explicitly lacks editor host/runtime. Not a Linux-only gap.
findings.product_omission_intent: Not established: guard safety rationale is explicit; feature qualification remains unfinished work.

findings.title: Interrupted Ollama chat overwrites successor admitted by cancellation terminal callback
findings.root_cause: api_ollama.lua M.chat:246 invokes M.cancel then resumes epoch increment (:247) and active-owner assignment (:293) without checking for a successor. M.cancel:371 publishes finish_request; its callback (:172) can admit C. The older B call overwrites C and later request_current suppresses all C callbacks. Remote cancel_exchange/open_exchange explicitly fence this kind of successor.
findings.silent_failure: Successor C has an admitted dispatch but never receives result or cancellation, potentially retaining its caller's pending state.
findings.regression_test: Real backend transcript with cancellation terminal observer admitting successor while competing chat is interrupted. Assert no overwrite and one terminal outcome per admitted request; also cover native cancel callback reentry.

findings.title: Refused translation dispatch leaves permanent loading offer
findings.root_cause: prediction_engine.lua open_offer:1632 opens loading/advances epoch; translate_selection dispatch at :2186 ignores backend.chat false. Real api_remote open_exchange:941-942 can refuse cancellation and chat:1169 returns false without terminal callback. Old response is correctly stale, leaving nobody to retire the new loading state. Ordinary prediction :1088-1097 already handles this same contract.
findings.silent_failure: New translation reports accepted and retains spinner/predicting forever despite owning no dispatched response; automatic predictions remain blocked until another cancel/action.
findings.regression_test: Actual engine and remote backend, repeated translation with native cancellation refusal then eventual old completion. Assert clean refusal or one retirement of new loading, stale response suppression, successor preservation, and synchronous completion controls.

findings.title: Excluded collection spans remain inside typing sequences and durations
findings.reproduction:
{
  "command": "/workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/lua-5.4.8/src/lua docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-04-deep/linux-metrics/probe-boundary.lua",
  "steps": [
    "Record a@1000; optionally flush with repository fake transport.",
    "Enter pause/private/secure/suppressed/disabled state; attempt X@1100; exit state.",
    "Record b@1200 and space@1300; flush."
  ],
  "observed": "All 10 cases produce word ab count1, bigram ab count1 td200, typing_time_ms300; excluded X is absent.",
  "expected": "An explicit exclusion terminates observed typing continuity; no invented ab word/bigram or credited cross-exclusion inter-key delay.",
  "evidence_path": "docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-04-deep/linux-metrics/probe-boundary.log",
  "limits": "Real core/shared walker with repository fake writer and isolated preferences; no real SQLite COMMIT claim."
}
findings.silent_failure: All calls succeed and filtered text stays absent, while persisted aggregate payload invents contiguous text and includes excluded elapsed time; dashboards cannot identify the discontinuity.
findings.regression_test: Cover five public exclusion paths both within one pending snapshot and across an acknowledged flush; require excluded X absent, no cross-boundary ab ngram/word, zero cross-boundary timing credit, retained valid a/b history; add pending/failed/retried flush boundary case.

findings.title: Configuration restore announces restart even when restart is refused or unavailable
findings.reproduction:
{
  "command": "/workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/LuaJIT-2.1/src/luajit docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-04-deep/linux-lifecycle/probe-restore-restart.lua",
  "environment": "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/debian/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu; LUA_CPATH=/workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/debian/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/lua/5.1/?.so;/workspace/scratch/parity-toolchain/modules51/?.so;;",
  "steps": [
    "Use real changelog bridge through existing authenticated document fixture and successful backup restore model.",
    "Make state.restart return false, then test absent state.restart.",
    "Post restore_backup; inspect returned response and shared restored-phase message."
  ],
  "observed": "Both return phase=restored with no restarted/reason metadata; shared page displays Configuration restored: ErgoptiPlus restarts on it.",
  "expected": "Preserve acknowledged restored bytes and pre-image, but visibly state restart required/refused rather than claiming restart.",
  "evidence_path": "docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-04-deep/linux-lifecycle/probe-restore-restart.log",
  "limits": "Effect-isolated backup/restart fixture, real bridge+shared locale. No real byte restore or process restart claim in this probe."
}
findings.silent_failure: Restart failure is log-only; user sees restart success wording while old runtime can remain active on stale configuration. Restored disk bytes are not claimed lost.
findings.regression_test: Cover successful handoff, false/missing/throwing restart; require visible restored-but-restart-required outcome, preserved pre-restore path and restored bytes; do not turn restart refusal into file rollback.
findings.other_os: Deduplicate with analogous macOS restore/reload reporting finding; Windows source has explicit restore reload-handoff/refusal owner.

findings.title: Linux advertises and accepts three unreachable horizontal-axis gesture slots
findings.root_cause: manifest.toml:3287,3344,3401 and menu_gestures.lua:114 expose Linux axis slots. manager.lua:291 includes them in editable defaults and set_action:1235 accepts them. slot_report.lua:25 only checks finger count. Actual _slot_for_gesture:1918/dispatch_gesture:1952 select only tap or named direction, while shared actions.toml:116 explicitly documents axes as macOS-only.
findings.silent_failure: A binding saves and appears reachable but never fires; generated website inventory also declares Linux support from the false source declaration.
findings.regression_test: Enumerate every advertised Linux slot through actual recognizer/dispatcher traces or an explicit unsupported reason. Include each horizontal aggregator alone plus left/right positive controls, and verify menu and generated matrix agree with runtime capability.

findings.title: Clearing persistent MT coordinate registers on lift drops subsequent valid gestures
findings.root_cause: mt_decoder.lua:299 drops slot.x/y at tracking ID -1; reset:220 clears all slot registers and current slot at :221-222, called on gesture completion :413. Kernel MT absolute registers persist across contacts and unchanged fields can be filtered (existing input_core_emulation.lua:42-55). centroid:241 requires both coordinates at :244, so a fresh horizontal contact lacking unchanged Y never contributes.
findings.silent_failure: A valid configured gesture produces no output or diagnostic until both required coordinate axes happen to be reported again.
findings.regression_test: Pass successive gestures through existing input-core filtering into one decoder, covering unchanged X/Y, reused slots, stationary contacts and changed-axis controls. Separate protocol-register lifetime from gesture state, with independent startup/SYN_DROPPED recovery policy.
